name: Pure tungsten (EWP)
use: The old standard for AC aluminium on transformer machines; balls easily. Largely replaced by lanthanated and ceriated.

name: 2% Ceriated (EWCe-2)
use: AC or DC; strikes easily at low amperage. Good for thin material and small parts.

name: 1% Lanthanated (EWLa-1)
use: AC or DC; less common than the 1.5% and 2% lanthanated grades.

name: 1.5% Lanthanated (EWLa-1.5)
use: General purpose on AC or DC: a good all-round tungsten.

name: 2% Lanthanated (EWLa-2)
use: Performs much like thoriated on DC steel and stainless, without the radioactivity. Increasingly the default for DC work.

name: 1% Thoriated (EWTh-1)
use: Lower-thoria version of EWTh-2; now rarely stocked.

name: 2% Thoriated (EWTh-2)
use: Long the standard for DC steel, with excellent arc starts. Slightly radioactive (thorium), so grinding dust needs extraction; being phased out.

name: Zirconiated (EWZr-1)
use: AC aluminium: holds a clean balled tip and resists contamination from the puddle.

name: Other / unspecified (EWG)
use: Any blend not covered above, such as proprietary rare-earth mixes; the maker states the additive.
